title: Dice Box
tagline: Up to five fair dice in a glass box. The box is the phone: shake it and the dice fly, tilt it and they slide.
status: v0.2: draft, not yet endorsed. Realistic dice, a loaded die, breakable glass. Engine checks pass; real-phone testing is pending.

stages.title: Prototype v0.1
stages.summary: Up to five 16 mm dice on felt under glass. The phone's measured acceleration and rotation drive the box frame directly, with no gesture detection. Rigid-cube contact engine at 480 Hz, an in-page fairness test, and drag-to-shake on a computer.

stages.title: Realistic dice, a loaded die, breakable glass
stages.summary: Drilled, painted pips and one colour per die, shown again in the readout. Setup loads one die with a hidden plate, from fair to heavily loaded, and sets the acceleration at which the glass box shatters and spills the dice.
